svg.text: Owen's own rig as a black silhouette: amber rim, lit eyes, a smile. No legs: below the waist it narrows into one thread tied to whatever feeds it.
One glow preset everywhere; embers only at stage 4 and at the moment it wins.
THE THREAD: FOUR STATES, FIXED MEANINGS
amber typewriter, lowercase, typed on letter by letter next to it
• same rig as Owen: no extra animation work
• only at stage 4 does it get his tuft (the reveal)
• the thread is a pull, never a tail or a leash
